results.question: How are sales doing?
results.answer: Interpreting sales as gross revenue, this calendar month is at $129,727.00, versus $596,810.84 last month—a decrease of 78.26329696022277%. as of 6:43 AM EST
results.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS current_month_start, (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AS previous_month_start, (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AS next_month_start), revenue AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE o.placed_at >= b.current_month_start AND o.placed_at < b.next_month_start), 0) AS current_month_cents, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE o.placed_at >= b.previous_month_start AND o.placed_at < b.current_month_start), 0) AS previous_month_cents FROM orders AS o CROSS JOIN bounds AS b WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.placed_at >= b.previous_month_start AND o.placed_at < b.next_month_start) SELECT current_month_cents / 100.0 AS current_month_revenue_usd, previous_month_cents / 100.0 AS previous_month_revenue_usd, (current_month_cents - previous_month_cents) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous_month_cents, 0) AS revenue_change_percent FROM revenue LIMIT 1000
